verdict.rationale: Otter documents a public API with webhooks (listed on the pricing page) and promotes custom integrations built on that API, plus an official MCP server, so developers do have a first-party programmatic surface to build against. Nothing in the evidence mentions official SDKs or client libraries, so building likely means working against the raw API. Missing for 10: any evidence of official SDKs or client libraries in any language, API reference or developer docs, and hands-on developer corroboration.
